svg.title: The Total Field Arc — Expanded
svg.desc: The Biospiral in the established embodied-meeting arrangement, with distinct scope annotations for Structon, Motive Infinity, dimensional operators, the Loom, Kaion, and the trans-structural Zenon relation. Draft for architect review.
svg.text: Expanded architecture • placement, operation, and scope
Aion ∩ Latent Khaon • prior to motion
The frame denotes scope, not a station
First Centropic Hypostasis • Essence of Being
First Inverse Hypostasis • Void of Self
Non-awareness • event horizon into Absolute Dispersion
Φ₁ / Φ₃: still co-presence • Φ₂: active traversal
▦ THE LOOM • patterning lattice of the arcs
L₅–L₁ and IL₅–IL₁ • expression, memory, resonance
Φ₂ MOTIVE INFINITY • Absolute Motion through both arcs
Recommended Loom scope: both hypostatic segments • L₀ record-relation remains architect-held
Scope brackets add no layers. Dimension-family rails do not assign every operator to every stratum.
Page positions express structural relations; Aion and Khaon remain co-present at L₀.
